title: Integrations, pulled into orbit
description: force layout · node = monthly syncs · drag a node, the web fights back

props.name: data
props.description: Services with stable IDs, display names, nullable nonnegative monthly syncs in thousands and a tier (0, 1 or 2). Diameter remains 8 + syncs × 0.75.

props.name: hubId
props.description: ID of the hub. Every other service connects to it; the caller supplies the hub rather than the runtime inventing one.

props.name: sideRoads
props.description: Additional directed source/target service IDs. Unknown endpoints are omitted; repeated directed links keep their first occurrence.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
